newsitem.title: USA: Continental Choice sells unit for $13 mln.
newsitem.headline: Continental Choice sells unit for $13 mln.

text.p: Continental Choice Care Inc said Thursday it signed a definitive agreement to sell most of its assets, including its dialysis treatment business, to IHS of New York Inc for $13 million cash. In addition, Continental will recieve $1 million from IHS during the course of a three-year consulting agreement.

The assets of Renal Management Inc, a subsidiary of Continental, will not be acquired by IHS. Continental will also retain its cash, accounts receivable, cash equivalents and certain other assets and liabilities.
Continental said the sale, still subject to shareholder approval, would allow it to explore acquisition and merger opportunities, including those not in the health care industry.
